name: Cassegrain reflector telescope
definition: Telescope whose concave primary and convex secondary mirror fold the light back through a hole in the primary, with no full-aperture corrector plate.
notes: Omegon Pro CC 154/1848: parabolic primary, hyperbolic secondary, no lens in path; shop filter Cassegrain (12)

name: Telescope tripod
definition: Tripod made to carry a telescope mount head, sold apart from the mount; a universal photo tripod is D4.
notes: Shop category Tripods & Mounts (165); Berlebach tripods each made for named mounts

name: Mount counterweight
definition: Weight fitted on the counterweight shaft of a telescope mount to balance the tube.
notes: Shop category Counterweights (130), listed by weight and mount brand

name: Tube rings (tube clamps)
definition: Pair of rings or a clamp that holds a telescope tube on a mount dovetail.
notes: Shop category Tube clamps (53); products also titled Tube Rings; sized by tube diameter

name: Polar scope (pole finder)
definition: Small sighting scope fitted in an equatorial mount's polar axis to align it on the celestial pole.
notes: Shop category Pole finder (68); optical and electronic polar finders for named equatorial mounts

name: Equatorial wedge
definition: Tilting plate that sets a fork or alt-az telescope mount at the latitude angle to track equatorially.
notes: Shop category Equatorial wedges (26), also titled polar wedge; for mounts and SCT forks

name: Eye loupe
definition: Loupe in a short tube held in the eye socket, leaving both hands free; also called watchmaker's loupe.
notes: Aven Eye Loupe 10x rests in eye socket; shop subcategory Watchmaker's loupe (11)

name: Laboratory condenser
definition: Jacketed glass tube through which coolant flows to turn vapour back into liquid in distillation or reflux.
notes: Chemglass Allihn reflux condenser CG-1207-03; category Condensers under jointed glassware

name: Laboratory autoclave
definition: Pressure chamber that sterilises laboratory ware, media and waste with steam.
notes: Autoclaves & Steam Sterilizers category; Tuttnauer lab autoclaves listed as Laboratory Autoclave

name: Laboratory shaker
definition: Device that mixes samples in vessels by orbital, reciprocating or rocking motion.
notes: Shakers, Rockers & Rotators category; IKA KS 130 orbital shaker; orbital, linear, reciprocating types

name: Rotary evaporator
definition: Device that removes solvent from a sample by rotating a flask in a heated bath under reduced pressure.
notes: Rotary Evaporation category; IKA and Heidolph systems titled Rotary Evaporator System; Buchi calls it Rotavapor

name: Laminar-flow cabinet (clean bench)
definition: Cabinet that blows HEPA-filtered air over the work surface to keep samples free of contamination.
notes: Laminar Flow Hoods category and Laminar Flow / Clean Bench category; horizontal and vertical

name: Biosafety cabinet
definition: HEPA-filtered enclosed cabinet that protects the user, the sample and the room when handling biological material.
notes: Biological safety cabinet listing (Class II A2); labdepot lists Ductless Biosafety Cabinets
